verses.1: To David, the LORD says: “My soul will be at peace.”
verses.2: I trust in you, O God. May my enemies not succeed in their plans against me.
verses.3: Nor will all your idols be able to deceive those who are faithful. The deceivers will surely be destroyed.
verses.4: Your ways, LORD, have shown me your paths. They have guided me.
verses.5: Guide me in your truth, and teach me, for you are the God of my salvation. I cry out to you every day.
verses.6: Remember, O LORD, your mercies and your kindnesses, for they are eternal.
verses.7: May the sins of my youth and my transgressions not be remembered, for your mercy is great. Remember me, O LORD, for your own good.
verses.8: May the Lord be good and righteous, so that His sins may be forgiven in His own way.
verses.9: He will guide the wicked in judgment, and teach the wicked their way.
verses.10: May all the blessings of Jehovah be with His covenant people and their leaders.
verses.11: So that your name may be Jehovah, and so that you may forgive me for my sins. For they are many.
verses.12: Who is this man who fears the Lord and follows His ways?
verses.13: His soul will rest in peace, and his seed will inherit the earth.
verses.14: The Lord shows His love to those who fear Him, and He makes a covenant with them.
verses.15: My eyes are always fixed upon Jehovah, for He is who makes my feet walk.
verses.16: Turn your face away from me, and treat me as if I were the only poor and lonely person in the world.
verses.17: The sorrows in my heart have grown more intense from the sufferings I endure.
verses.18: Look at my hardships and toil, and forgive all my sins.
verses.19: Look, my friends, how many there are who hate and despise me.
verses.20: May your soul protect me and save me from harm, for I have trusted in you.
verses.21: God has created me, because you have called me.
verses.22: May God save Israel from all its troubles.
